ንዑ: ንዓ — come! (2mp imperative ንዑ of the defective ንዓ, which serves as the imperative of መጽአ)
ወየሐውሩ: ሖረ — and they go (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
ብዙኃን: ብዙኅ — many (adjective, plural ብዙኃን, used as a noun)
ወንሖር: ሖረ — and let us go (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, ḥ-w-r)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
ወዘንተሰ: ዝንቱ — and this, indeed (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ሰ)
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
ወወልድ: ወልድ — and the Son · and 'a son' in general (ወወልድ ለአብ 'and a son to the father')
ወአሐቲ: አሐዱ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
ሙ: ሙ — -ሙ, detached pronominal suffix; it completes the preceding እምኔክ as እምኔክሙ 'from you (pl.)' (suffix, 2mp) · here completing አባሕኩክ as አባሕኩክሙ 'I … you (pl.)' (suffix -ሙ, 2mp, split from its word by the wordspace) · here completing ዐውዶ as ዐውዶሙ 'around them' (suffix -ሙ, 3mp) · here completing ሕዘቢሆ as ሕዘቢሆሙ 'their peoples' (suffix -ሙ, 3mp, split from its word by the wordspace)
ወአሐተ: አሐቲ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem., accusative አሐተ)
ይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — they bow down (3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
ወበምድር: ምድር — and on earth (ወ- + በ- + noun)
ወበቀላያት: ቀላይ — and in the deeps (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ቀላያት)
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
